abstract.text: A type whose values can persist beyond their immediate local scope.

inlineContent.text: Escapable values can be assigned to global or static variables, returned from functions, captured by escaping
closures, and so on. All Swift types implicitly conform to this protocol by default, allowing them to be moved across
scopes freely because they lack any lifetime dependencies.
In contrast, values of types that suppress their implicit conformance to
carry a lifetime dependency. These dependencies ensure the
value does not live longer than the value it
depends on. Explicit lifetime dependency annotations may be required when working with these types.
